coastline_policy: Modern reference land follows sourced OSM natural=coastline mean-high-water springs (MHWS) land. Intertidal elevations, reefs and submerged banks are retained named marine evidence, not inflated territorial land.

decisions.name: Blenheim Reef
decisions.status: intertidal-low-tide-elevation; no high-water land footprint invented
decisions.basis: ITLOS Special Chamber official judgment28 April2023, para146 treats Blenheim as low-tide elevation after parties2022survey. Older generalized gazetteer lists4cays without comparable high-water evidence; explicit later primary-source precedence. OSM0rings alone not no-land proof.
decisions.short_quote: Blenheim Reef, as a lowtide elevation situated partly within 12 nm of Île Takamaka
decisions.full_pdf_not_redistributed: Public access verified; reproduction terms not separately established; source URL/full byte hash retained
decisions.independent_nautical_qualification: NGA Pub.171 Fifteenth Edition2026, corrected30April2026, section8.27, states nearly covered at high water except southern extremity. Its observation date and high-water datum are unspecified. Retain this qualification alongside ITLOS2023 low-tide elevation classification; neither text supplies a positive-area MHWS polygon.

decisions.name: Speakers Bank
decisions.basis: Retained named article states drying cays and Big Speaker Reef just reaches high-water mark. Neither independent GeoNames IO island catalogue nor OSM queried domain supplies an above-high-water land footprint. This is a source-supported tidal classification rather than absence alone; modern chart-grade high-water delineation unverified.
decisions.source_date: 2026-10-03 retrieval; source geographic observation date unknown
decisions.scope: Land inclusion would require positive-area high-water evidence, not drying reef outline
decisions.independent_nautical_evidence: NGA Pub.171 Fifteenth Edition2026, section8.27/pages127–128, describes coral/sand/rock bank with edge depths5.5–14.5m and42m centre. Independently corroborates marine-bank role; does not expressly exclude every tiny drying cay. Exact source URL, PDF hash, copyright notice and short excerpt retained in independent-nautical-evidence.json.

limits: Conventional eight named island/atoll groups reviewed exhaustively within declared complete-source windows; worldwide survey/coastline precision not certified.
Speakers Bank lacks independently verified modern chart-grade high-water delineation; no positive-area high-water land inferred from drying cays.
Blenheim and Speakers tidal marine features have fixed South Asian Indian Ocean Islands association; any future above-high-water evidence requires sourced footprint proposal, not water-cell donation.
Individual source-name points outside modern coastline retain alias/vintage uncertainty; source geometry is not shifted to name points.
Regional interior granularity remains a separate audit; existing Chagos territory ID/name/parents/history preserved.
Canonical grid representation and publication not performed by this source-only stage.
